text:
pagerbot: ALERT: automated pager fired -> high 5xx rate (inference-gateway) in prod-usw2. threshold breached: 7m avg error-rate 12% :rotating_light:

oncall-john: acked. I'm on it. grabbing dashboards now.

samir: saw a spike on the edge too, maybe an auth proxy flapping? linking grafana: https://grafana.company/ d/abcd/inference-gateway?orgId=1

laura_ops: fyi customers A and B reported degraded responses ~5m ago. tickets opened.

maria_sre: checked upstreams — origin pool eu-west has many 502s around the same time. could be origin-side timeouts.

oncall-john: running quick curl check against edge route:
```
curl -sv -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' https://api.prod-usw2.company/v1/infer -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
```
response shows HTTP/1.1 502 on 3/5 attempts, latencies ~1200ms.

samir: deploying a transient route fallback to dedicated-capacity to reduce customer impact. triggering now.

deploy-bot: deploy started by samir: rollout infer-gateway-fallback v2026.03.17-ff2 -> canary 10%

laura_ops: customer-impact: subset of requests hitting large context models timed out. UX shows "Something went wrong" for a minority of requests. CS triaging.

oncall-john: toggled canary to 50% to divert more traffic. watching 5xx rate.

maria_sre: logs from origin proxy (snip):
```
2026-03-17T02:14:10Z origin-proxy ERROR backend_timeout id=xyz svc=embedder host=10.2.4.8
2026-03-17T02:14:11Z origin-proxy ERROR connection_reset id=xyz svc=embedder
```

samir: increasing connection pool on origin proxy and bumping upstream timeouts +5s. will validate after 30s.

oncall-john: 5xx rate dropped from 12% -> 3% in the last 3m. still above baseline but improving :thumbsup:

laura_ops: keep CS updated. opening postmortem placeholder. tagging support leads.

maria_sre: recommend follow-up actions: 1) origin infra healthcheck, 2) add circuit-breaker to reduce fanout, 3) investigate recent config change to origin-proxy (maybe culprit).

samir: agree. I'll keep the fallback route for 1hr then revert if stable.

oncall-john: thanks all — I'll stay on watch for next 20m. escalate to eng-sre if it resurfaces.

pagerbot: NOTE: pager auto-resolve scheduled if error-rate <2% for 10m. current: 3%
